description: Era buckets used by analysis/cama_affect_dataset.py when first-class schema_version/tagger-era columns are absent. Boundaries are UTC dates, end-exclusive. These are analytic labels, not claims about the memory content itself.

eras.name: pre_2026_import_or_early
eras.rationale: Pre-2026 imported or early records before the current public CAMA schema and evaluation story stabilized.

eras.name: 2026_q1_schema_settling
eras.rationale: Q1 2026 memory imports and schema-settling period.

eras.name: 2026_april_research_push
eras.rationale: April research/publication push; useful boundary for checking wrapper-voice and paper-era tagging effects.

eras.name: 2026_may_pre_may7
eras.rationale: Early-May live memory period before the May 7 boundary called out in the CAMA Affect v1 review notes.

eras.name: 2026_may_post_may7
eras.rationale: Post-May-7 period before the May 18 public repo stabilization pass.
